description: NaInBr₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Na is bonded to six Br atoms to form distorted NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with four equivalent InBr₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one InBr₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.28 Å. In is bonded to four Br atoms to form InBr₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of In-Br bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.55 Å. There are four inequivalent Br sites. In the first Br site, Br is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one In atom. In the second Br site, Br is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one In atom. In the third Br site, Br is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one In atom. In the fourth Br site, Br is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Na and one In atom.
